title: Michael Moorcock Hawkmoon The Mad God’s Amulet 1-4 Complete Set First Comics
descriptionText:
The product is a complete set of four comic books from the Hawkmoon series titled "The Mad God's Amulet," written by Michael Moorcock and published by First Comics. These vintage comics feature the character Hawkmoon and are part of the US Comics tradition. Perfect for collectors and fans of graphic novels, this set captures the essence of the classic Hawkmoon storyline in a comic book format.

Complete 4 issue limited series from First Comics
Michael Moorcock’s Hawkmoon The Mad God’s Amulet
Includes issues 1 2 3 and 4
Based on the classic fantasy novel by Michael Moorcock
Published by First Comics
Copper Age fantasy science fiction series
